text_copy_copy_copy.text: Stroke Knowledge Initiatives for Learning and Leadership (SKILL) is a series of innovative, tailored ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke education programs that support our customers’ need to address patient management challenges with the ultimate shared goal of improving lives. SKILL features an e-lab, NeuroElite fellows program, training center initiatives and global centers of excellence.

text_copy_copy.text: This site provides multidisciplinary healthcare professionals a peer-to-peer learning experience focused on the advancement of Fluorescence Guided Surgery.
